title: Transformations and congruence
summary: Reflections, translations, rotations, congruent figures and triangles, tessellations, quadrilaterals, similar figures and similar triangles.

cards.title: Reflection
cards.rule: A mirror image: each point is the same distance from the mirror line.

cards.title: Translation
cards.rule: A slide, with no turning or flipping.

cards.title: Rotation
cards.rule: A turn, given by a centre, an angle and a direction.

cards.title: Congruent figures
cards.rule: Exactly the same shape and size (≅). Reflections, translations and rotations keep figures congruent.
lines: Matching sides and matching angles are equal
Write the vertices in matching order

cards.title: Congruent triangles
lines: SAS: two sides and the angle between them
AAS: two angles and a side
cards.tip: AAA isn't a test: same angles can be different sizes.

cards.title: Tessellations
cards.rule: Shapes that cover a surface with no gaps or overlaps. The angles at each point add to 360°.
lines: Regular pentagons don't: 108° doesn't divide evenly into 360°

cards.title: Congruence and quadrilaterals
cards.rule: A diagonal can split a quadrilateral into congruent triangles, which proves its properties.
lines: A parallelogram's diagonal makes two congruent triangles, so opposite sides are equal
A rhombus's diagonals cross at right angles

cards.title: Similar figures
cards.rule: Same shape, different size. Scale factor \(= \dfrac{\text{image length}}{\text{original length}}\).

cards.title: Similar triangles
cards.rule: Same angles, sides in the same ratio. Use the scale factor to find missing sides.
lines: Matching sides 3 and 12: scale factor 4, so side 5 matches \(20\)
A 1 m stick has a 2 m shadow; a tree's shadow is 10 m: the tree is \(5\) m tall
